data.text: Emma, I won’t accept 8 tons for an uncertain chance at more next month. I propose Luke 14, John 12, and Emma, Kate, and Jack 8 each. That still totals 50 tons and restores the lake to 100 after reproduction. John, your 12 stays intact—would you support this allocation? Kate and Jack, would you accept 8, or what whole-ton shares would you seek?
